scope: Source-only architecture audit and stopped metadata preflight; no implementation, numeric source access, model execution or publication.
conclusion: A separately labeled experimental public expectation may use a genuine model-estimated participation probability. Confirmation, p=1, prior benchmark superiority and completion of the private finite research frame are not universal requirements. The current skater producer/admission path lacks a modeled-probability branch; the general resolver already supports one.

findings.finding: Released scoped probabilities in [0,1] are accepted with identity, event-basis, revisions, clock, expiry and use checks. Expected mean is conditional mean times probability once. Missing probability remains null.

skater-participation-v1 requires independently reconstructed confirmed full-strength lineup or explicit-out evidence with matching evidence IDs and scalar. No modeled skater probability branch is accepted here.
The current native producer derives skater participation only through skaterParticipationFromEvidence. Legacy role/availability multipliers are explicitly not probabilities.

Atomic skater revision admission emits expected stats and withholds a conditional-only forecast when expected is null. This is an implementation contract to extend explicitly, not a proof that all public probabilities require confirmation.

Participation is currently composed from an already admitted GameForecast. A released native conditional baseline alone does not supply a separate public participation catalog. A validated catalog or a versioned modeled atomic branch is needed.

The goalie path already accepts an estimated start probability and labels it uncalibrated_model unless confirmed. It explicitly assumes zero non-start relief; start and appearance probabilities are not interchangeable.

These are pure fixed historical frame/diagnostic helpers, not a probability producer. Within web/lib their only importing callers found by the bounded name search are their nearest tests. Their fixed cohort/date and disconnected qualification rules need not be imported into a separately versioned public product path.

The reader records a schedule completeness limitation after 36 hours; this line is not a universal hard rejection of every forecast. An old clock is not evidence that the schedule is wrong. The approved metadata preflight separately required stopping on stale scope, so no bypass, refresh or remaining live read occurred.

smallestProductPath: Freeze one named/versioned deterministic participation estimator or assumption rule with legitimate native inputs and an exact event definition; no candidate search or private research outputs. A genuine rule/input receipt is required even when calibration is unknown.

Issue one separately versioned experimental participation receipt per actual player-game. Bind canonical/NHL/team IDs, season/game, schedule/roster revisions, event basis, probability, method/input hashes, original source cutoff, actual pregame issuance, expiry, use permissions and limitations.

Add a validated public participation catalog to planning composition, or explicitly version the native skater atomic modeled branch. Propose ownership of shared planning/admission files before editing; preserve the confirmed-evidence v1 and private pilot.

Reuse unchanged native supported conditional rates and the existing resolveContribution multiplication. Preserve units and missing heads, integrate once, propagate probabilityStatus=uncalibrated_model and calibration unavailable through DTO/RSO/Start Chart.

Generate and retain separate per-game receipts for each next-game/selected-week/next-N scope; aggregate the admitted game contributions and probabilities. Do not multiply one game's forecast by N or reuse its confirmation for later games.

Review a concrete hash-pinned genuine payload, then separately authorize any publication/activation and bounded matching consumer readback. Neither this audit nor the stopped metadata lease authorizes writes.
essentialCorrectness: Actual reproducible estimator/rule and permitted real inputs; an arbitrary scalar relabeled as a model is insufficient.

Participation event matches the conditional target population. Positive minutes, dress, official credit, start and relief are distinct; zero/missing TOI and penalty-only PIM must retain the stated population/exclusions.

Exact current identity/team/schedule/roster scope, original source clocks, genuine pregame issue, finite probability [0,1], conflict rules, expiry, source and participation use permissions, one integration and explicit head coverage.

Use a complete opportunity denominator when estimating an empirical participation fraction or fitting with nonappearances. Appearance-only rows do not provide that denominator, and an absent row is not a zero.
Label model status, assumptions and calibration unavailable truthfully. Any sensitivity range is an assumption range unless independently supported as an interval with stated coverage.
For goalies preserve mutually exclusive team-game start mass and the relief limitation; do not reinterpret start probability as appearance probability.
notUniversalPublicPrerequisites: A superiority threshold or completed private model comparison.
An untouched historical holdout or historical original-as-of certification for a new genuine prospective experimental issuance.

remainingFacts: No current public skater participation-model artifact or admitted genuine expected tuple was identified within the named producer/loader source scope.
The stopped metadata lease did not inspect player/native-history/participation support. It establishes neither broad source coverage nor a viable genuine pair.

Before resuming this stopped metadata lease, amend its stale-stop scope explicitly: retain the stale limitation if acceptable for investigation, or separately authorize a guarded current schedule reconciliation/refresh. Any future serving-policy change must preserve old fetchedAt and independently justified validationAt. A local reader timestamp is not a new upstream capture; the reader's limitation alone is not a blanket ban on experimental forecasts.
The local read/view/consumer plumbing and its prior verification remain separate from genuine issuance, release, account availability and deployment.
